about: The acceptance floor of the dish-picture judge (project 010): the judge’s stored answers for the 68 pictures of the 2026-09-27 pilot, reduced.

Produced once, on 2026-09-30, by a script kept outside the repository, from the pilot’s private record: the 57 pictures judged again with the judge the product uses (set "rejudged"), the 8 of the mini-pilot (set "mini") and the 3 wrong-recipe controls (set "control").

Kept per picture: the foods the vision call named (name, amount, specific) with its marks for the picture (realism, sharpness, plasticOrCgi, extraDishes; nonFood is the number of objects it listed, not their names), what the match call answered (each ingredient’s status and matched names, and the extras), and the recipe’s ingredients (slug, the English name the picture is drawn from, grams).
Left out: the allergens the vision call offered (the rule never reads them), its free-text remark, the model that drew each picture, every file name and every recipe id.

No dish name: the pilot’s dishes come from a private library, so each recipe’s title is "Plato del piloto NN". Today’s rule does not read the title (checked: real and neutral titles give the same verdicts). The rule of project 010 will read it as one way to find a dish’s own form, so a neutral title can only make that rule stricter on these pictures, never looser.

The controls are a picture drawn for one recipe ("drawnFor") judged against another ("recipe"). Their match call’s answer was not stored, only the verdict. It is rebuilt, as an assumption: the extras are the verdict’s extras (which were that call’s extras), the seen foods are those same foods with the amount and the flag the verdict kept, and every ingredient is not_seen with nothing matched (the verdict says so of the mains; of the rest it is assumed).

"accepted" and "notes" are what judgePicture answered for each picture with the seed catalogue on 2026-09-30, before the rule changed. They are the pin: 65 accepted with these notes, 3 controls rejected.
